label: Note
description: Sticky note. Optionally connect a text input to feed it dynamically — append mode logs each incoming string (e.g. an LLM transcript), replace mode overwrites. Leave the input unconnected for a normal hand-edited note.

label: Frame
description: Groups multiple nodes visually inside a frame.

label: Image File
description: Loads a static image from your local drive.

label: Movie File
description: Plays a video file with playback and scrubbing controls.

label: Webcam
description: Captures live video feed from your system camera.

label: Solid Color
description: Generates an image of a custom solid color.

label: Grayscale
description: Converts the image to grayscale.

label: Blur
description: Smooths the image. Multiple methods (Gaussian, Median, Box, Bilateral, Motion). Connect a mask to blur only that region.

label: Canny Edge
description: Detects edges using the Canny algorithm.

label: Threshold
description: Separates the image into black and white based on intensity.

label: Invert Color
description: Inverts all colors in the image (negative effect).

label: Bright & Contrast
description: Adjusts the brightness and contrast of the image.

label: Sobel Edge Detector
description: Detects horizontal and vertical gradients using the Sobel operator.

label: Color Space
description: Convert RGB image to HSV or CIE Lab color space for advanced analysis and processing.

label: CLAHE (Contrast)
description: Adaptive local contrast enhancement (CLAHE). Choose the color space to operate in, dose the effect, and optionally restrict it to a mask region. 'Auto Clip' derives the clip limit from local contrast; the 'luma' output exposes the equalized luminance channel.

label: Gamma Correct
description:
Applies a gamma power-law to image intensities (ch7 §7.6).

I_out = I_in ^ gamma   (values normalised to [0, 1])

gamma < 1  →  brightens midtones (e.g. 0.45 = sRGB encode)
gamma = 1  →  identity
gamma > 1  →  darkens midtones (e.g. 2.2 = sRGB linearise)

Use 'Linearise (÷ 2.2)' to decode sRGB before linear-space operations (blur, colour arithmetic, luminance computation).

label: Image Levels
description: Adjusts image intensity levels: black point, white point, gamma (midtones), and output range.

label: Shadow & Highlight
description: Selectively brightens shadows and darkens highlights while preserving midtones, similar to professional photo editors.

label: Adaptive Threshold
description:
Local thresholding: computes a per-pixel threshold from the neighbourhood mean
minus a constant C. Robust to uneven illumination (ch12 §12.2).

Block Size must be odd; pixels darker than (local_mean − C) are set to 255.

label: White Balance
description: Correct color cast. Gray World scales channels to a common gray mean; White Patch maps the top-percentile brightness to white; Manual applies temperature (R/B) and tint (G/M) gains.

label: Bilateral Filter
description: Smoothes the image while preserving edge sharpness and textures.

label: Gaussian Noise
description: Adds Gaussian noise to simulate film grain or a noisy sensor.

label: Salt & Pepper Noise
description: Adds random white and black pixels (impulse noise).

label: Speckle Noise
description: Adds multiplicative noise to simulate complex interference.

label: Gabor Filter
description: Oriented Gabor filtering for edge and texture analysis. Builds a Gabor kernel (cv2.getGaborKernel) and convolves the image.

label: Filter: High Pass
description: Extracts fine details and edges by removing low frequencies. Useful for frequency separation.

label: Filter: Low Pass
description: Applies a Gaussian low-pass filter to smooth the image and reduce noise.

label: Laplacian
description: Computes the discrete Laplacian (∇²) of an image in float32 precision. Essential for reaction-diffusion diffusion step.

label: Image Clamp
description: Clamps all pixel values of a float image between min and max. Prevents overflow in iterative pipelines (reaction-diffusion, accumulators).

label: Image Gradient
description: Computes image gradients (magnitude and orientation) using Sobel or Scharr operators.

label: Channel Split
description: Splits an image into its 3 (or 4) channels as grayscale images. Purely positional: works on whatever 3-channel image is connected, whether it's BGR, HSV or Lab. Set 'Input Color Space' to relabel the ports correctly (e.g. after a Color Space node's HSV output, port R actually carries Value, G carries Saturation, and B carries Hue) — this is cosmetic only, the split itself never changes.

label: Channel Merge
description: Merges R, G, B (and optional A) channel images into a single composite image.

label: Blend
description: Blends two images. Normal = linear opacity mix. Advanced modes: Multiply, Overlay, etc.

label: Pixelate Filter
description: Reduces the apparent resolution of the image to create a pixelated effect.

label: Glitch FX
description: Applies random digital distortions for a 'glitch' effect.

label: Threshold (Advanced)
description: Advanced thresholding including Otsu's method and relative percentage thresholds.

label: Morphology (Advanced)
description: Advanced morphological operations like Opening, Closing, and Gradient.

label: Distance Transform
description: Calculates the distance from each pixel to the nearest zero pixel (mask border).

label: Connected Components
description: Labels connected regions in a binary image. Each region gets a unique ID (Markers).

label: Connected Components
description: Label and count connected regions (particles, cells, blobs). Measures area and centroid of each object.

label: Marker Filter
description: Filters markers (label map) by area, removing regions outside the min/max range.

label: Watershed
description:
Separates overlapping objects using marker-controlled watershed algorithm.

Rescue Unseeded Regions: when a Cell Mask is connected, any region of that mask containing no marker is normally claimed by the background basin and disappears from the result — a silent loss that hits small objects first, because a seed threshold set as a percentage of the distance map's global maximum never reaches them. Turn this on to give every unseeded region its own marker (placed at its distance-transform peak) before flooding, so nothing is dropped.

label: Find Contours
description: Detects and extracts isolated shapes from a binary image (mask).

label: Contour Properties
description: Calculates geometric metrics (area, center, perimeter) of an isolated shape.

label: Filter Contours
description: Filters a contour list by elongation (long/short axis ratio) and/or area. Use min_elongation > 1 to keep only elongated shapes like rivers. Connect an image to preview the kept contours.

label: Fill Contours
description: Fills all contours from a list into a binary mask (union). Connect contours_list from Find Contours.

label: Hough Circles
description:
Identifies perfect circular shapes in the image.

Parameters:
- DP: Inverse ratio of accumulator resolution (1.0 = full, 1.2 = recommended).
- Min Dist: Minimum distance between centers of detected circles.
- Canny High: Upper threshold for internal edge detection.
- Threshold: Center accumulator threshold (lower = more circles, but more noise).
- Min/Max Radius: Bounds for detected circle size in pixels.

label: Hough Lines
description: Detects straight line segments in the image (walls, joints, etc.). Outputs the detected segments as a list AND an overlay image with the lines drawn (ch10 §10.4).

label: K-Means Segmentation
description:
Colour segmentation via K-Means clustering on pixel values (ch12 §12.4).

Each pixel is replaced by the centroid colour of its cluster. Work in Lab
colour space (perceptually uniform) for better cluster quality.

label: Local Binary Pattern
description: Local Binary Pattern texture descriptor. Encodes each pixel by thresholding its circular neighborhood, then outputs a colored map and histogram.

label: SSIM / PSNR
description: Compare a test image against a reference: computes SSIM (structural similarity) and PSNR (peak signal-to-noise ratio). Outputs an SSIM map, difference image, or the test image with metrics overlaid.

label: Fill Holes
description:
Fills internal holes in a binary mask.

Useful for cells with central pallor (erythrocytes), hollow particles, or any ring-shaped objects where the interior void would otherwise displace distance transform peaks.

Method "Contour Fill": fills by re-drawing external contours solid — fast, removes all internal holes regardless of size.
Method "Flood Fill": floods from image border — preserves holes touching the border.
Method "Size Filter": removes only holes smaller than max_hole_px.

label: Mask Operations
description: Perform bitwise operations between two masks.

label: Circle Mask
description:
Generates a circular (or elliptical) binary mask.

Center is expressed as % of image width/height. Radii are expressed as % of the SHORTER image side, so equal X and Y radii always give a true circle, whatever the aspect ratio. Set them differently to get an ellipse.

Connect an image to inherit its size; otherwise set Width/Height manually.

Feather > 0 softens the edge inwards over that many pixels. Feather = 0 gives a hard binary circle.

Combine with Mask Operations to cut a disc out of another mask.

label: Mask Point Query
description: Checks if a point (x, y) falls within a mask. Returns True if the mask value at that point is non-zero.

label: Mask to Image
description: Converts a binary mask (1 channel) to a standard image (3 channels).

label: Skeletonize
description: Reduces a binary mask to its 1-pixel medial line and outputs it as a clean mask (ready for Directional Dilate). Pre-cleans by removing small blobs and closing holes. Methods: Skeletonize (Zhang-Suen), Medial Axis, or OpenCV thinning fallback.

label: Directional Dilate
description: Orientation-aware dilation. Dilates each pixel with a short line kernel aligned to the local tangent (structure tensor), so collinear gaps (bridges, canopy) close while parallel branches stay separate. Use to repair a broken skeleton / hydrographic network. Fixed-angle mode applies one global direction.

label: Float Threshold
description: Thresholds a raw float32 array (e.g. NDVI, elevation) directly without 8-bit quantization loss. Connect the 'raw' output of Float Image. Water: -0.5→0.0, Vegetation: 0.2→1.0.

label: Draw Arrow
description: Draws an arrow from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2). Coordinates are normalized [0,1].

label: Draw Ellipse
description: Defines an ellipse to be displayed over the video stream via Draw Overlay.

label: Draw Line
description: Defines a line between two coordinates for graphical overlay.

label: Draw Point
description: Defines a graphical point to overlay on the image.

label: Draw Rect
description: Defines a rectangle to be displayed over the video stream.

label: Draw Text
description: Draws text on an image or creates a graphic element. Connect text to the 'text' input and optionally an 'image'.

label: Draw Overlay
description: Draws graphical elements and AI detections over an image. Supports dynamic multi-inputs.

label: Tint Mask
description: Colorizes a region defined by a binary mask over a base image. The masked area is blended with the chosen color at the given alpha. Chain multiple Tint Mask nodes to colorize independent zones.

label: Mask Polygon
description: Interactive polygonal region of interest — draws a mask, optionally restricted by an input mask.

label: Oriented Bounding Box
description: Computes minimum-area oriented bounding box from mask contours and outputs a deskewed auto-rotated crop.

label: Distortion Correction
description: Remove radial/tangential lens distortion using a pinhole camera model built from focal length and distortion coefficients.

label: Rotate Image
description: Applies a custom rotation and scaling to the video stream.

label: Offset Shift
description: Shifts the image horizontally or vertically with wrapping.

label: Crop
description: Crops a rectangular region from the image. Define the region interactively using the built-in editor.

label: Auto Cropper
description: Crops a rectangular area from the image using detection coordinates.

label: Remove Vignette
description:
Removes circular vignette (dark border) from images with a round field of view.

Works for microscopy, telescope, fisheye, or any circular FOV. Auto-detects the bright circle or use Manual mode for precise control. Feather blends the edge softly. Outputs cleaned image + FOV mask.

label: Region Filter
description: Filters markers/labels based on their pixel area. Removes objects that are too small or too large.

label: Region Properties
description: Extract shape and intensity features from a labeled region map. Outputs: area, perimeter, circularity, aspect_ratio (elongation), eccentricity, solidity, convexity, extent, rectangularity, roundness, anisotropy, equivalent_diameter, orientation, centroid, bbox. Connect image for mean/max/min/std intensity per region.

label: Visual Calibration
description:
Calculates a calibration factor by drawing a line of a known physical length on the image.

Two ways to read the result, both always computed:
• Px/Unit — pixels per unit of the length you typed (e.g. px/mm)
• µm/px — microns per pixel, the convention Region Properties and Grain Stats expect

Recognised units: µm, mm, cm, m, in. Any other unit name leaves µm/px unavailable.

label: Unit Calibration
description: Converts pixel measurements (length or area) into real-world units based on a calibration factor.

label: Image Moments
description: Computes spatial moments and Hu invariants for a single connected shape (ch2). Outputs raw moments M_pq, central moments μ_pq, normalized moments η_pq, centroid, orientation θ, anisotropy, and the 7 log-scaled Hu invariants φ₁–φ₇. Binary Mode ON → pure geometry (mask). Binary Mode OFF → intensity-weighted centroid (barycentre lumineux, sub-pixel localisation).

label: Analysis Report
description: Displays a beautiful summary table of all variables. Connect any dictionary (stats, report, etc.).

label: First Order Statistics
description:
First-order texture statistics from the pixel histogram (ch13 §13.1).

Outputs mean, variance, entropy and uniformity — purely statistical,
blind to spatial arrangement. Demonstrates the angle mort of order-1 descriptors.

label: Image Normalizer
description: Normalize image or data array. Min-Max, Z-Score, or percentile stretch. Essential preprocessing for scientific imaging.

label: Area Statistics
description: Measure pixel statistics (mean, std, min, max) inside a rectangular region of interest.

label: Color Distance
description:
Pixel-wise color distance map between image and a reference color (ch3).

L1 = Σ|Δc|, L2 = √(Σ Δc²), L∞ = max|Δc| (§3.1 — Minkowski).
Cosine = 1 − (A·B)/(|A||B|) : shape similarity, ignores brightness (§3.3).
Mahalanobis: accounts for channel correlations and variance (§3.2).

Reference source: 'Ref Mask' region mean (if connected), else 'Ref Color' picker.
Outputs a float32 distance map (normalized 0–1 for display), a threshold mask,
and the scalar min distance.

label: Delta E
description:
Perceptual colour difference between two images (ch7 §7.3).

Converts both images to CIE L*a*b* and computes ΔE per pixel.

CIE76 : ΔE = √( (ΔL*)² + (Δa*)² + (Δb*)² )
CIE2000 : weighted formula that fixes blue-saturation over-estimation.

Perceptual thresholds:
  ΔE < 1     : imperceptible
  ΔE 1–2     : visible to trained eye
  ΔE 2–10    : noticeable at first glance
  ΔE > 10    : clearly different

Outputs: false-colour map + scalar statistics.

label: Channel Formula
description:
Computes a per-pixel expression on image channels, outputting a float32 grayscale result.

Available variables: R, G, B (0–255 float), H, S, V (HSV 0–255 float), L, A_lab, B_lab (LAB channels).

Math: abs, sqrt, clip, log, exp, sin, cos, min, max, mean, std, np, pi.

Examples:
  B*0.5 + R*0.3 - G*0.8      (purple stain score)
  (R - G) / (R + G + 1e-6)   (red vs green index)
  clip(V - S*0.5, 0, 255)     (brightness minus saturation)

label: Histogram
description: Statistical distribution of pixel intensities. Performs radiometric analysis of input data across spectral channels for scientific validation.

label: Histogram Compare
description:
Compares histograms of two images using classical similarity metrics (ch3 §3.4–3.5).

χ² (Chi-squared): sensitive to bin differences, good for textures.
Bhattacharyya: geometric mean — 0=identical, 1=no overlap.
Wasserstein 1D: Earth Mover's Distance along the chosen channel.
Correlation: Pearson correlation between histograms (1=identical, -1=opposite).

Channel: Luma (perceptual Y), R, G, B, or Hue (H from HSV).
Optional masks restrict the region analysed.
Output: scalar distance + side-by-side histogram overlay.

label: Mask Metrics
description:
Compares a predicted binary mask to a ground-truth mask (ch4).

Outputs IoU (Jaccard), Dice (F1-pixel), Precision, Recall, F1, and raw VP / FP / FN counts.

Colored overlay: green=VP, red=FP, blue=FN — reveals immediately whether the error leans toward over- or under-segmentation.
IoU = VP/(VP+FP+FN) — doubly penalises both over and under-segmentation.
Dice = 2·VP/(2·VP+FP+FN) — always ≥ IoU; same ranking, more forgiving.
Precision = VP/(VP+FP), Recall = VP/(VP+FN), F1 = harmonic mean.

label: Line Profile
description: Extract intensity profile along a line segment. Fundamental in microscopy, spectroscopy, and materials analysis.

label: Scale Bar
description: Overlay calibrated scale bar on image. Set Pixels/Unit to match your Unit Calibration node.

label: Focus Metric
description: Measure image sharpness / focus quality. Higher score = sharper. Use for autofocus, Z-stack selection, QC.

label: Noise Estimate
description:
Reference-free noise and SNR estimation (ch14 §14.1).

sigma: robust Gaussian-noise std via Immerkaer's Laplacian estimator (cancels image structure up to 2nd order, so it measures the random floor, not the edges).
snr_db: 10*log10(mean^2 / sigma^2).
gain_a, read_b: affine fit of the Poisson-Gauss variance law Var(I) = a*I + b, from local mean vs local variance — a is the photon-shot gain, b the electronic read floor.

Linearise the image first (ch7): the affine law only holds in linear space. Saturated / clipped pixels are excluded from the fit.

label: Matrix Distribution
description: Histogram and distribution analysis of float matrix data.

label: Colormap / LUT
description: Apply scientific colormap (LUT) to grayscale image. Converts intensity to false color for visualization.

label: Value Gate
description:
Compares values in a dict against configurable reference ranges.

For each key in the input dict, define a normal range (warn_lo–warn_hi) and a critical range (crit_lo–crit_hi) in the JSON ranges param. Outputs a status dict (OK / HIGH / LOW / CRITICAL per key) and a visual dashboard image.

Range JSON format:
{"key": [crit_lo, warn_lo, warn_hi, crit_hi], ...}

label: Region Color Stats
description:
Enriches a regions list with per-region color statistics.

Takes the label map and original image, computes mean/std for each BGR channel and HSV channel per labeled region. Outputs an augmented regions list compatible with Region Classifier and Region Props.

New fields added to each region dict: mean_b, mean_g, mean_r, std_b, std_g, std_r, mean_h, mean_s, mean_v, dominant_hue.

label: Frame Accumulator
description: Accumulate frames over time: mean (noise reduction / Monte-Carlo P), std (motion / uncertainty map), temporal diff, running max/min. Cumulative mode aggregates ALL frames since reset (stable N-sample estimate); window mode keeps only the last W frames (sliding average).

label: GLCM
description:
Grey-Level Co-occurrence Matrix + Haralick features (ch13 §13.2–13.3).

Quantises the image to `levels`, builds P(i,j | d, θ) averaged over selected
angles (rotation-invariant), then computes Haralick scalars:
contrast, homogeneity, energy (ASM), entropy, correlation.

Outputs a visualisation of the GLCM matrix and all five Haralick scalars.

label: Hausdorff Distance
description:
Hausdorff distance between two binary masks (ch3 §3.6).

H(A,B) = max(h(A→B), h(B→A)) — worst-case mismatch.
h(A→B) = max_{a∈A} min_{b∈B} d(a,b) — directed Hausdorff.

Percentile < 100 gives Modified Hausdorff / HD95 (robust to outliers).
Uses distance transform (fast O(N)) instead of brute-force O(N²).
Overlay: A=cyan, B=orange, worst-case pair connected by red line.

label: Boundary F1
description:
Boundary F1 score (BF) between two binary masks (ch4 §4.6).

Extracts contour pixels from both masks and computes precision/recall with a pixel tolerance: a predicted boundary pixel counts as correct if a ground-truth boundary pixel exists within the tolerance radius.

P_c = boundary pred pixels near truth  / total pred boundary
R_c = boundary truth pixels near pred  / total truth boundary
BF  = 2·P_c·R_c / (P_c + R_c)

BF complements Hausdorff: BF is a bounded proportion, Hausdorff reports the single worst-case mismatch.

IoU = intersection / union of the two full masks (global overlap, not boundary-only) — useful contrast against BF since IoU can be low on large/blobby regions even when the boundary itself is well-matched.
Overlay: cyan=pred boundary, orange=truth boundary, green=matched.

label: Robust Box Fit
description: Fits a bounding box to a mask's foreground pixels, in two modes (ch15 §15.x, robust losses). Ordinary takes the literal min/max extent — a single outlier blob (a sticker next to the real object) stretches the box to swallow it. Robust rejects pixels whose x or y coordinate is more than `tolerance` scaled-MADs from the median before measuring the extent, the same idea Huber loss applies to regression. Both boxes are drawn for direct comparison; the chosen mode's box is also reported numerically.

label: Region Classifier
description:
Classifies labeled regions using a user-defined Python rule.

Connect a regions list (from Region Props or Region Color Stats) and a label map, then write your classification logic in the code block. The variable `r` is a dict of all region features. Return a string class label.

Outputs: classified regions list, counts per class, colored overlay.

params.label: Classification Rule
params.default:
# Classify each region. Variable `r` is a dict with all region fields.
# Return a string class label.
#
# Available fields (if upstream nodes connected):
#   r['area_px'], r['circularity'], r['aspect_ratio'], r['solidity']
#   r['mean_r'], r['mean_g'], r['mean_b']   (needs Region Color Stats)
#   r['mean_h'], r['mean_s'], r['mean_v']   (needs Region Color Stats, BGR+HSV)
#
# Example — classify by size:
if r.get('area_px', 0) < 60:
    return 'Small'
elif r.get('circularity', 0) > 0.75:
    return 'Round'
else:
    return 'Other'

label: Cluster Heatmap
description: False-color each labeled region by a feature value (area, circularity, intensity…). Requires a label map and the regions list from Region Props. Includes a colorbar legend with min/max values.

label: Scalar List
description: Type a list of numbers (comma or space separated) and output them as a list port — the input source for the robust-statistics nodes of ch16. Example: '2, 3, 5, 7, 800'.

label: Robust Location
description: Mean vs median of a scalar sample (§16.1). Also reports how much the LAST value moves each estimate — the mean's influence is unbounded, the median's is bounded (it only counts sides). Push one sample to a wild value: the mean drifts, the median stays put.

label: MAD Scale
description: Robust scale of a scalar sample (§16.2): median, MAD, calibrated sigma_hat = 1.4826*MAD, and the modified z-score z = 0.6745*(x-median)/MAD per value, flagging |z| > 3.5 as an outlier. The MAD ignores the aberration that would blow up the classical standard deviation.

label: M-Estimator
description: Robust location by an M-estimator, solved by IRLS (§16.3–§16.4). Pick Huber (psi clipped at ±k, bounded but never zero) or Tukey (psi redescends to 0, outliers fully rejected). The threshold is in units of sigma_hat (MAD). Outputs the robust estimate vs least-squares, the final per-point IRLS weights, and plots the influence curve psi.

label: Boundary Seeds
description: Generates seed markers for Watershed from a boundary/corner mask. Finds the centers of the 'empty' regions.

label: Segmenter
description: Versatile segmentation tool. Combines contrast enhancement (CLAHE), seed detection, and watershed for object separation.

label: Linearity Filter
description: Filters out non-linear noise and keeps only straight segments at any angle.

label: Region Sealer
description: Bridges gaps in boundary masks and fills closed regions to create solid blobs.

label: Direction Filter
description: Suppresses or isolates linear elements based on their orientation (angle in degrees).

label: Anisotropic Morphology
description: Performs morphological operations (Dilate, Close, etc.) along a specific axis (Horizontal or Vertical).

label: Canvas
description: Generates a procedural float32 image. Patterns: solid fill, center dot, noise, value noise, checkerboard, stripes, dots, gradients, rings. Static by default (caches result); enable Animate for live generation. Designed for reaction-diffusion init and generative pipelines.

label: Feedback
description: Outputs the previous frame's image. Essential for iterative algorithms (reaction-diffusion, cellular automata, blur loops). Output lags input by exactly 1 frame.

label: Gray-Scott
description: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion simulation. Stateful: runs N iterations per frame. Connect Canvas nodes for U/V init, or let it self-initialize. Connect a grayscale image to 'mask' for image-guided RD (bright=pattern, dark=suppressed). Reset to restart.

label: EVM Color
description: Eulerian Video Magnification — color amplification (Wu et al. 2012). Amplifies subtle Cr/Cb variations (pulse, perfusion) via Gaussian pyramid + IIR bandpass. Optional mask input: restricts both analysis and amplification to masked pixels (skin ROI). Default params target resting pulse (50–60 BPM). Outputs: amplified video + scientific signal (mean bandpass Cr ×1000, oscillates at pulse rate).

label: Motion Amplifier
description: Eulerian Video Magnification — motion amplification (Wu et al. 2012). Amplifies subtle spatial motions via Laplacian pyramid + IIR bandpass per level. Optional mask input: restricts both analysis and amplification to masked pixels. lambda_c attenuates fine spatial scales (paper: 16px for micromotion). attenuation clamps filtered signal before alpha multiply (guards against transients). motion_mag output = mean absolute motion amplitude per frame.

label: Grain Size Histogram
description:
Interactive grain size histogram + cumulative frequency curve rendered inside the node.
Connect 'Regions' from SAM Grain Stats or from Region Properties.

Shows D10 / D50 / D90 percentiles, count, mean, and std directly in the chart.
Units follow the upstream calibration (px when uncalibrated, µm otherwise).

label: Barefoot Print Forensics
description:
Forensic analysis of a BARE FOOT print on a deskewed crop. Computes pressure zones, foot length and width in mm, per-zone widths, Staheli Arch Index with its Cavus / Normal / Flat classification, medial-lateral asymmetry and pressure centroid.

The Staheli index is the arch area divided by the non-heel area: it describes a plantar arch and is meaningless on a shoe sole. Use this on bare prints only.

Connect geom_obb rotated + rotated_mask outputs, and px_per_mm from a calibration.

label: Face Tracker
description: Detects and tracks faces and facial landmarks (MediaPipe).

label: Hand Tracker
description: Detects and tracks hands and joints (MediaPipe).

label: Pose Tracker
description: Analyzes and tracks human body posture (33 keypoints) via MediaPipe.

label: Object Detector
description: Detects common objects (80 categories) using the fast MediaPipe model.

label: Point Tracker
description: Extracts the precise coordinates of a specific tracked landmark (e.g., joints).

label: Coord Combine
description: Combines 4 scalar values into a coordinate dictionary.

label: Coord Splitter
description: Extracts the first two numeric values from a dictionary (e.g., x, y).

label: List Selector
description: Extracts a specific item from a list by its index.

label: Dict Get
description: Extracts 1 to 3 values from a dictionary by key name. val_1/2/3 outputs accept any downstream type; scalar_1 coerces val_1 to float.

label: Region Selector
description: Filters and sorts a list of detection regions. Outputs the selected item and its canonical 4 corner pts (TL→TR→BR→BL) ready for perspective warp.

label: List Ops
description: List operations: sort, reverse, unique, slice, flatten, append, length, contains.

label: Landmark Selector
description: Selects specific points from a landmark list (e.g., torso from pose).

label: Merge Dicts
description: Combines multiple dictionaries into a single one. Useful for combining statistics from different sources into one report.

label: Group Dicts
description: Groups multiple dictionaries (e.g. data outputs) into a single list of dictionaries.

label: Build Dict
description: Assemble a dictionary from multiple scalar inputs. Keys are auto-labelled from the connected source and can be renamed in the inspector.

label: Moving Average
description: Sliding-window mean. Reduces noise but introduces latency (window/2 frames).

label: Exp. Smoothing (EMA)
description: Exponential moving average. alpha=1 = no smoothing, alpha→0 = heavy smoothing.

label: Kalman Filter
description: 1D Kalman filter. Q = process noise (dynamics), R = measurement noise.

label: Median Filter
description: Sliding-window median. Excellent spike/outlier rejection.

label: Savitzky-Golay
description: Polynomial least-squares smoothing. Preserves peak shapes. window must be > polyorder.

label: Low-pass Filter
description: 1st-order IIR low-pass. cutoff in mHz, fps in Hz. Attenuates frequencies above cutoff.

label: Holt-Winters
description: Double exponential smoothing. Tracks level AND trend. alpha=smoothing, beta=trend.

label: Gaussian Smooth
description: Convolves signal buffer with a Gaussian kernel. sigma controls spread.

label: LOESS / LOWESS
description: Local regression smoother. span = fraction of points used for each estimate.

label: Particle Filter
description: Sequential Monte Carlo estimator. particles = N hypotheses about the true state.

params.label: Python Script
params.default:
# ── Inputs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

label: Collect
description: Appends values to a list while the condition is true. Exports to CSV on demand.

label: Signal Gate
description: Passes or blocks a value based on a gate signal. Hold-last mode retains the last passed value when gate closes.

label: Latch
description: Holds the last valid (non-null, non-zero) value. Useful for intermittent detections. Optional reset trigger.

label: Data Compare
description: Compares two numerical values using a selected operator (>, <, ==, etc.) and returns true or false.

label: Presence Check
description: Checks if a list is not empty or if a value is non-NULL. Useful for triggering events.

label: Switch
description: Toggles between two input streams based on a control signal (true/false).

label: Logic Gate
description: Performs basic logical operations (AND, OR, XOR, NOT) on two signals.

label: Label Filter
description: Filters a list of detections to keep only specific labels (e.g., 'person').

label: Math Expression
description: Evaluates a math expression. Connected inputs map to a, b, c… in connection order. Supports: sin, cos, sqrt, clamp, lerp, log, pow, pi, e, (a+b)/c, etc.

label: Map Range
description: Remaps a scalar from [in_min, in_max] to [out_min, out_max]. Optional clamp.

label: Math Op
description: Performs simple mathematical operations (+, -, *, /) on two numerical values.

label: Plotter Pro
description: Real-time multi-series plotter. Dynamic scalar and dict inputs, a fixed 'ticks' input to synchronise curves, per-series toggles, normalization, and dict + dataframe outputs. Resizable.

label: Inspector
description: Displays the raw data content flowing through a link.

label: Display
description: The output terminal displaying the final video stream.

label: CSV Export
description: Exports data to CSV. Dynamic inputs — connect any value to add a column. Use Recording for live streams or Snapshot for single-frame capture.

label: Note
description: Adds a textual annotation or comment to the workspace.

label: Reroute
description: Helper to organize connection lines and fan out signals.

label: Flip
description: Inverts the image horizontally or vertically.

label: Resize
description: Reduces the image resolution to accelerate downstream processing.

label: Color Mask
description: Creates a mask by isolating a range of colors (HSV or RGB distance).

label: Morphology
description: Dilation or erosion operations to clean up masks.

label: Coord To Mask
description: Transforms detection coordinates into a white mask.

label: Mask Blend
description: Combines two images using a binary mask as a transparency layer.

label: Optical Flow
description: Analyzes movement between frames using Farneback algorithm.

label: Flow Visualizer
description: Colorized visualization of optical flow data.

label: Monitor
description: Universal measurement tool for flow, area, brightness, and counting objects.

label: List → DataFrame
description: Builds a table from one or more lists — one column per connected input. Optionally adds a frame index and a time column, so a recorded series can be plotted against seconds rather than sample number.

params.label: Time column at N fps (0 = none)

label: Dict to DataFrame
description: Builds a DataFrame from a dict. Scalar values give one row (one column per key); list/array values give one row each and scalars are broadcast to match. Key/Value mode emits a 2-column (metric, value) table instead. Connect to DF Collect or DF Export.

label: DF Column → List
description: Extract one DataFrame column, as a list (array) and as a single-column DataFrame. Reusable everywhere a 'list' is accepted — wire it into DataFrame Plot X/Y, a Plotter, or stats. Blank column = the first one. Optionally drop NaNs and coerce to numeric.

label: DF Select
description: Keep specific columns, drop others, or rename them. Columns: comma-separated names. Drop: columns to remove. Rename: old:new,old2:new2.

label: DF Sort
description: Sort rows by one or more columns. Column: comma-separated names for multi-level sort.

label: DF Sample
description: Extract a subset of rows: head (first N), tail (last N), random sample, or slice (start:end).

label: DF Slice
description: Keep a contiguous range of rows, by position (rows 10 to 200). End = -1 means the last row; negative positions count from the end (Start -100, End -1 = the last 100 rows). Step > 1 keeps every Nth row. Start / End can also be driven by wired scalars.

label: DF GroupBy
description: Group rows by a column and aggregate numeric columns. Result is a new DataFrame with one row per group.

label: DF Merge
description: Merge two DataFrames on key columns (SQL-style join). Connect left and right DataFrames.

label: DF Fill NA
description: Handle missing values: fill with constant, statistics, forward/back fill, or drop rows/columns.

label: DF New Column
description: Add a computed column using a Python expression. Use df['col'] to reference columns. Example: df['a'] + df['b'].

label: DF Rename
description: Rename columns. Format: old:new,old2:new2. Leave blank to pass through unchanged.

label: DF Collect
description: Accumulates incoming DataFrames into one growing table. Auto-captures whenever the 'seq' input changes (e.g. a folder iterator's index) — perfect for batch pipelines. Without 'seq' connected, use the Capture trigger manually. Connect to DF Export at the end.

label: DF Editor
description: Interactive DataFrame cell editor. Double-click cells to modify values.

label: DF Export
description: Save a DataFrame to CSV, Excel, JSON or Parquet. Trigger the Save button once to write the file. Connect the Filename input to override the base name (e.g. from a Folder Images filename) — the folder and extension from File Path are kept.

label: DataFrame Plot
description: Generic DataFrame chart. One node, many chart types (line, bar, scatter, histogram, box, area, pie) with styling options. Renders in the node body and outputs an image. Either connect a DataFrame + pick X/Y column names, or wire raw X/Y arrays directly (e.g. CSV Reader columns). X/Y inputs win over the table.

label: ORB Detector
description: Detects keypoints and computes ORB descriptors (fast and efficient).

label: SIFT Detector
description: Detects high-quality scale-invariant keypoints (SIFT algorithm).

label: FAST Corners
description: Rapid corner detection optimized for real-time performance.

label: Harris Corners
description: Detects corner points using the Harris mathematical operator.

label: Feature Matcher
description: Matches features between two sets of descriptors using BF or FLANN and draws matching lines.

label: HOG Descriptor
description: Histogram of Oriented Gradients. Splits the image into cells and draws, in each, the dominant gradient orientations (perpendicular to edges). Outputs the HOG visualisation and a compact global orientation histogram (signature) that stays stable under small rotations — the basis of pedestrian detection.

label: Gabor Bank
description:
Multi-orientation Gabor filter bank (ch13 §13.5).

Applies N_theta Gabor filters (magnitude of complex response). Each
filter responds only to edges/threads at its own orientation and at the
chosen wavelength (thread spacing).

Outputs:
• Orientation Map — per-pixel dominant orientation (colour-coded).
• Responses Grid — the N individual responses in one labelled montage,
  all on a SHARED brightness scale so panels are directly comparable.
• Energy Map — per-pixel max energy across orientations.
• Signature — mean energy per orientation (a texture signature vector).
• Orientations — N_theta (scalar).

label: Structure Tensor
description:
Computes the structure tensor J in each pixel's neighbourhood (ch6 §6.4).

J = [Σ(Ix²)   Σ(IxIy)]
    [Σ(IxIy)  Σ(Iy²) ]   (Gaussian-weighted sum over neighbourhood)

Eigenvalues λ₁ ≥ λ₂ of J reveal local geometry:
  λ₁ ≈ λ₂ ≈ 0   → flat region
  λ₁ ≫ λ₂ ≈ 0   → edge (one dominant direction)
  λ₁ ≈ λ₂ ≫ 0   → corner / texture

Overlay: blue=flat, green=edge, red=corner.
Harris response R = λ₁λ₂ − k·(λ₁+λ₂)² also computed.

label: RANSAC Line Fit
description: Fits one dominant line to the white pixels of an edge map. RANSAC keeps the consensus line supported by the most inliers (robust to false lines); Least Squares fits all points (dragged off by outliers). Reports the inlier count and the line angle, and overlays the fit.

label: Skeleton
description:
Reduces a binary mask to its medial axis (skeleton) (ch11 §11.5).

Method: Distance Transform + local maxima (crêtes de la carte de distance,
consistent with ch10 §10.5). Each skeleton pixel is the centre of a maximal
inscribed disc — the skeleton and the DT encode the same geometry.

Outputs: skeleton overlay, branch count, max inscribed radius.

label: Mask Statistics
description: Computes statistics from a binary mask: area (px), area % relative to ref_mask, centroid (x, y), bounding box width and height. Connect ref_mask for area_pct relative to full footprint. Connect image for intensity-weighted centroid (pressure centroid).

label: Shape Gate
description:
Filters connected regions by shape descriptors (ch1 — Décrire une forme).

Circularity C = 4π·A/P²: 1.0=perfect circle, drops when elongated OR edge rough.
Aspect Ratio (elongation) E = L_max/L_min from oriented bbox: 1.0=square, high=elongated.
Solidity S = A/A_convex: 1.0=fully convex, drops when concavities/fusions present.
Convexity Cv = P_convex/P: 1.0=smooth hull, drops when edge is rough/jagged.
Eccentricity e = √(1-λ₂/λ₁): 0=circle, →1=needle, mass-weighted.
Roundness Rd = 4A/(π·L_max²): 1.0=circle, insensitive to edge roughness.

All active filters are AND-combined. Disable any to use only the others.
Preview: natural colors=kept, dimmed=rejected, bounding box colored.

label: Background Subtractor (MOG2)
description: Separates moving foreground objects from a static background (MOG2).

label: Background Subtractor (KNN)
description: Separates moving foreground objects using K-Nearest Neighbors approach.

label: BG Removal
description: Subtracts the static background to isolate only moving objects.

label: Optical Flow (Lucas-Kanade)
description: Sparse optical flow: Shi-Tomasi corner detection (goodFeaturesToTrack) tracked frame-to-frame with the pyramidal Lucas-Kanade method (calcOpticalFlowPyrLK). Stateful: keeps the previous frame and tracked points across frames in a 30fps stream.

label: Object Tracker (SORT)
description: Real-time multi-object tracking using SORT (Kalman Filter + Hungarian). Connect the 'objects_list' output from a YOLO or MediaPipe detector.

label: Track Visualizer
description: Renders SORT/DeepSORT tracks: boxes coloured per ID, labels and trajectory trails.

label: Line Tracker
description: Calculates the distance in pixels between two tracked landmarks.

label: Polygon Tracker
description: Calculates the area of a zone defined by multiple tracked landmarks.

label: Approx. Polygon
description: Simplifies a contour into a polygon with fewer vertices.

label: Fit Shape
description: Calculates the bounding box or minimum area rectangle for a contour.

label: Warp Affine
description: Applies a 2x3 affine transformation matrix to the image.

label: Rotate (No Crop)
description: Rotates the image while expanding the canvas to keep all pixels visible.

label: Perspective Warp
description: Straightens a distorted area into a flat rectangle using 4 reference points.

label: Manual 4 Points
description: Allows manual definition of 4 reference points on the image for calculations.

label: BBox Transform
description: Resize (enlarge/reduce) and size-filter bounding boxes. Accepts a boxes list or a single box dict (Grounding DINO / YOLO format). Resize by percent of box size or by pixels per side; filter by area (% of image or px²) or by width/height in px. Connect the source image for pixel-based modes.

label: Box Selection
description: Select a single box from a boxes list. Pick by index, or by ranking (largest / smallest area, highest score). Outputs one box dict ready for SAM (single box mode) or Auto Cropper. Connect an image for preview.

label: Coord Center
description: Calculates the center point of a coordinate dictionary (bounding box).

label: Fill Holes
description: Fills holes (black areas) inside white objects in a binary mask.

label: Apply Colormap
description: Applies a scientific colormap (Heatmap, Jet, Magma) to a grayscale image.

label: Image Math
description: Applies mathematical power operation (gamma) to image pixels.

label: Draw Contours
description: Draws a list of contours onto an image or a new black background.

label: Label Area Filter
description: Filters a label image (from Segmenter) by area. More precise than filtering a binary mask.

label: Mask Area Filter
description: Filters connected components (blobs) based on their area as a % of the image. Adaptive to resolution.

label: Image Masking
description: Applies a binary mask to an image. Pixels outside the mask are filled with a specific background color.

label: Mask Outline
description: Extracts the outline (boundary) from a binary mask. Useful for drawing borders around detected objects.

label: Mask Band
description: Extracts a band (start% → end%) from an image and/or mask along H or V axis. Values outside the band are zeroed. Use to isolate longitudinal zones.

label: Split Half
description: Splits an image and/or mask into two halves along H or V axis at a given % position. Values outside each half are zeroed (spatial positions preserved). Useful for medial/lateral or anterior/posterior asymmetry analysis.

label: Compose
description: Combines two images: side-by-side, split view, blend, difference, or checkerboard.

label: Image to Mask
description: Converts any image to a binary mask using its brightness.

label: Invert Mask
description: Inverts a binary mask (black becomes white and vice versa).

label: Points to Mask
description: Convert a list of points into a binary mask. Each point is drawn as a filled circle.

label: Plotter
description: Multi-series real-time graph. Connect any scalar/list inputs dynamically. Resizable.

label: Statistics
description: Calculates key statistical metrics (mean, median, standard deviation) from a list.

label: Density Heatmap
description: Generates a cumulative heatmap based on provided detection points.

label: List Aggregator
description: Extracts a key from a list of objects and computes group statistics (Sum, Mean, SD, Count). Useful for summarizing circle/contour lists.

label: K-Means Classifier
description: Clusters a list of objects (like circles) into K groups based on a numeric property. Adds a 'cluster_id' to each item. Cluster 0 = smallest value, cluster K-1 = largest.

label: Robust Pixel Stats
description: Mean, median, std and MAD (median absolute deviation) inside a rectangular ROI (ch16 §16.x). Median and MAD ignore a small fraction of extreme pixels (hot spots, sensor glitches) that drag mean and std off the true background level — compare the two pairs to see how much an outlier costs the non-robust estimators.

label: Compare Grid
description: Tiles N connected images into one labelled montage for side-by-side comparison. Inputs are dynamic — drag several image links onto the node (e.g. two segmentations with different seeds vs a third method). Each panel is resized to a common cell and labelled A, B, C…

label: Phase Space
description: 2D phase-space (Lissajous / attractor) plot for any pair of scalar signals. Fading colored trail.

label: IMU Phase Dashboard
description: 6-channel phase-space dashboard for IMU (2×3 grid): Accel XY/XZ/YZ + Gyro XY/XZ/YZ. For M5StickC Plus2.
